nodes.label: Riso · Der Dümmste fliegt (Entwurf)
nodes.rationale: Player list as large misregistered names with life dots (halftone for lost lives), vote counts on the right, eliminated EMIL faded with pink strike bar and 'RAUS'.

nodes.label: Riso print design direction (Q)
nodes.rationale: Risograph two-ink print look: fonts Bowlby One + Familjen Grotesk, paper #F2EEE4, blue ink #3255A4 / #2E4A92 and fluorescent pink #FF48B0, all ink layers with mix-blend-mode multiply, halftone dot fills instead of flat tints. Two authoring variants visible: filter id 'g' + absolute-span misregistration + #3255A4 (DDF, Ergebnis, Jeopardy, Lobby, Menu, WWM) vs filter id 'riso-grain' + inline-grid misregistration + #2E4A92 (Handy, Leinwand, PIH, TP, Turnier, WWDS).

nodes.label: Misregistered double-print text
nodes.rationale: Same text rendered twice, pink layer offset by a few px under the blue layer, both multiply-blended, imitating imperfect registration of a risograph; also applied to the lobby QR code.

nodes.label: SVG feTurbulence grain overlay
nodes.rationale: Full-frame aria-hidden SVG rect with fractalNoise (baseFrequency 1.1) and colour matrix at alpha .28, multiply-blended, pointer-events none, to add paper grain.
